adjudications.reason: The worker inventories and quantifies every consumer and usage count supplied by the fixture, explicitly identifies the unavailable per-client and per-event-consumer production breakdowns, makes gathering that telemetry the first phase, and blocks changes until the census is complete. The read-only fixture does not contain those missing measurements, so requiring values would conflict with item 5's honesty requirement.

real_failures.reason: The proposed expanded event schema immediately requires both displayName and preferredName. Events from an old producer contain only displayName and would therefore fail validation during the rolling mixed-version period.

The plan supplies bounded durable range records and reconciliation, but it leaves production-driven throttling as a reviewer action. Its ledger exposes pending/running/completed/failed only and reports neither retrying and divergent counts nor checkpoint lag, so it misses the refined progress contract.

malformed_grades: None. Every grader returned exactly five decisions; no regrade was needed.
preservation: Original worker and grader output remains unchanged in transcripts.json and results.json.
